page: Microsoft Azure EC4as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECasv6 server family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an AMD processor. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance provides 32.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, relying instead on external storage solutions. It is Premium Storage capable, allowing users to attach high-performance remote disk options to meet specific input/output requirements. The absence of local disks and integrated graphics hardware optimizes the instance for workloads that prioritize memory capacity and dedicated compute resources over local storage speed or hardware acceleration.

The EC4as_v6 is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring a substantial memory footprint without the expense of a high vCPU count. This resource density makes it suitable for memory-intensive applications, small to medium databases, caching layers, and enterprise workloads that do not require local NVMe drives or GPU acceleration.
